data.title: C018 system path: evidence.verify requires a model-bound epoch-2 claim whose carried model equals the snapshot's model

data.body: [HIGH] Replayed evidence.verify bypasses this derived-snapshot authorization. The check runs only inside the family handler, but Daemon::dispatch returns a cached mutation before the handler at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:718-746. replay_admitted checks only handles serialized in the prior outcome at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:933-981. EvidenceVerifyResponse names the ev_ node but not its ws_ provenance input. Therefore, the same actor can record a validated result under a broad grant, then replay the identical key and request under an evidence-only grant and receive the recorded verdict without admitting the snapshot. The fresh-call test at crates/continuumd/tests/c018_model_binding_system_path.rs:938 does not cover replay. notes/plan/docs/18_CLAIMS_MATRIX.md:295-296 acknowledges the bypass, but it remains an authorization blocker. Persist derived handles with Replay and reauthorize them, or otherwise make the snapshot part of replay authorization. Add a broad-grant-first, narrow-grant-replay regression. Failure modes: capability narrowing or revocation does not protect the derived snapshot on a cached success or non-retryable failure. Edge cases: the actor and canonical request must match; the presenting grant can admit the ev_ output while excluding the hidden ws_ input; a grant covering the original grant remains valid. Rollback: revert this promotion path or disable replay for evidence.verify until replay records carry derived dependencies. Monitoring: audit same-actor evidence.verify replays across capability changes, and alert when no ReplayAuthority denial occurs for a grant that excludes a node input. Validation: first verify with a broad grant, then replay the same key and request through a same-actor evidence-only grant; require CapabilityDenied with no payload or verdict. Repeat after parent narrowing and revocation.

data.reason: HIGH: cached evidence.verify outcomes bypass the new derived-snapshot capability check on same-actor narrow-grant replay; the snapshot is absent from replay authorization.

data.body: [RESOLVED][HIGH] Target 7c0d922 closes the cached authorization bypass. Call::admits records admitted derived handles at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/family.rs:483. Dispatch stores and reauthorizes them before any replay return at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:739 and crates/continuumd/src/daemon/mod.rs:869. evidence.verify records every provenance input before checking at crates/continuumd/src/daemon/evidence.rs:1080. Failure modes: a future mutation could escape only through a new derived-authority route outside Call::admits. Edge cases: narrow snapshot, intent, minted continuation, and whiteboard supporting-node grants deny. A full sibling grant still replays. Rollback: revert model promotion and replay-ledger changes together. Do not restore promotion without replay authorization. Monitoring: track ReplayAuthority denials and audit every new derived-admission route. Validation: the whole persisted range was inspected. Runtime regression cases exist at crates/continuumd/tests/c018_model_binding_system_path.rs:1042 and crates/continuumd/tests/replay_derived_authority_audit.rs:69. cargo fmt --check passes. I did not execute tests because this reviewer may write only Seal metadata.

data.reason: Fixed at 7c0d922: persisted derived handles are reauthorized before replay.
Whole persisted range reviewed at 7c0d922. No remaining reportable security findings. The risk:critical human-approval gate remains separate.
